title: Classical Mechanics
topics: Vector Algebra: Basic Operations, Differential Operators (Gradient, divergence, curl, and Laplacian) in curvilinear coordinate systems, Multivariable Calculus (total derivatives and chain rule)
Newtonian mechanics for a particle/system of particles: Conservation principles, etc.
Constrained Motions: Classification of constraints. Degree of freedom (DOF), generalized coordinates.
Systematic methods to eliminate/bypass constraints, Principle of virtual work, d’Alembert’s principle (may shock you at first and certainly test your patience!), Euler- Lagrange’s (E-L) equation
Setting up the problem through Lagrangian approach: Reduction of two-body problem to an equivalent one-body problem.
Two first integrals of motion, classification of orbits based on bounded/unbounded motion, stability criteria, closure property, etc.
